goal: Answer whether the documented API rate limit matches observed behaviour
caveat_block: Observations are descriptive: no causal claim, no guarantee about future behaviour.

questions.text: Does the observed 429 rate match the documented 60 requests/minute?

decision_rules.when: validate-window logs show throttling starting within 5% of 60 rpm
validate-window logs show throttling outside 20% of 60 rpm
validate logs are too sparse to decide
validate-window logs do not exist yet

questions.text: Does the documented backoff header match the observed retry-after values?

decision_rules.when: all sampled retry-after values fall in the documented range
any sampled retry-after value is outside the documented range
fewer than 10 samples in validate data
an independent confirm set is required and missing

questions.needs_data: an independent confirm set, collected after validate

stop_rules.when: two consecutive rejected vectors without new data
